messages.content: Return only JSON with keys observation and next. Observation: three cheap providers were permanently blocked by a default lifetime exchange-record cap; that implicit cap has been removed while explicit caps remain. State the throughput consequence and the next measurement needed to prove the cheapest sufficient supplier now carries ordinary work.

completion.text: {"observation":"Removing the implicit lifetime cap unblocks three low-cost providers; work forced onto higher-cost suppliers can now route to them, expanding capacity and lowering average cost per exchange. Actual utilisation stays zero until a request reaches one.","next":"Run a controlled batch of representative ordinary exchanges through the cheapest formerly-blocked provider and measure completed-exchange count, error rate, and latency against the current baseline supplier to confirm it handles normal load without hitting any remaining explicit cap or quality floor."}
